comment: Inputs of the corpus build (prediction.sqlite n-grams) and of its held-out sets, pinned by SHA-256 (plan corpus-light 0.2). Files live under $PEPITE_CORPUS_WORK/raw/<file> (or an adopted local copy, recorded only in <work>/local-paths.json); « repo_path » is relative to the repository root. use: train (n-gram counts), heldout (decision sets), test-only (context sets), private (never in a public build), selection (catalogue used to choose inputs), excluded (pinned but not used). public: false = never in a public release. A null sha256 is pinned once by « fetch_corpus.py pin-new » after review; fetch and verify refuse any mismatch.

tdm_check.note: Machine-readable TDM reservations (robots.txt, TDMRep, ai.txt, headers) of every source were checked on 2026-11-16, after collection, and are recorded per source in development/tdm-check-2026-11-16.md: no reservation found on the sources whose text is counted, except that TDMRep was not determinable for Leipzig (bot-check page) and Vikidia (HTTP 403) and that the live gutenberg.org was down (HTTP 503); its archived robots.txt (2026-11-04) and permissions page (2026-11-12), both before collection, show no reservation; download.kiwix.org's robots.txt Disallow is a crawler rule, not a TDM reservation; gutendex.com (catalogue used for selection only) showed Content-Signal ai-train=no.
